block.fancy_lanterns.murky_lantern.fizzl: This lantern has fizzled! Add fuel!
jei.fancy_lanterns.upgrade.level_1: Upgrade from Level 1 to Level 2 by right-clicking the placed lantern with an Iron Ingot or Iron Block. One item is consumed.
jei.fancy_lanterns.upgrade.level_2: Upgrade from Level 2 to Level 3 by right-clicking the placed lantern with a Gold Ingot or Iron Block. One item is consumed.
jei.fancy_lanterns.upgrade.level_3: Upgrade from Level 3 to Level 4 by right-clicking the placed lantern with a Nether Star, Netherite Scrap, or Nucleus Core. One item is consumed.
jei.fancy_lanterns.muted: Mute a placed lantern by right-clicking it with any Wool. One wool is consumed. Muting is permanent; there is no way to unmute the lantern.
